items.stem: A stratified random sample of size 50 is to be allocated by Neyman allocation between two strata with N₁ = 150, N₂ = 350, S₁ = 2 and S₂ = 2. The number of units to be selected from stratum 2 is
items.explanation: Neyman (optimum, equal-cost) allocation takes nₕ = n·NₕSₕ/ΣNₕSₕ. Here N₁S₁ = 300 and N₂S₂ = 700, total 1000, so n₂ = 50 × 700/1000 = 35. Trap: proportional allocation (nₕ ∝ Nₕ) gives 35; it agrees with Neyman only when S₁ = S₂.
